actions.acknowledgeIncidents.description: Acknowledge one or more Coralogix incidents by incident ID.
actions.acknowledgeIncidents.props.incid: List of incident IDs to acknowledge.
actions.assignIncidents.description: Assign one or more Coralogix incidents to a specific user.
actions.assignIncidents.props.assignToUs: The Coralogix user ID to assign the incidents to.
actions.assignIncidents.props.incidentId: List of incident IDs to assign. Find IDs via "List Incidents" or the Coralogix Incidents page URL.
actions.closeIncidents.description: Close one or more Coralogix incidents (e.g. false positives or noise). Use Resolve for incidents that were actually fixed.
actions.closeIncidents.props.incidentIds: List of incident IDs to close. Find the ID in Coralogix → Alerts → Incidents → click an incident → copy the ID from the URL.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.getIncidentById.description: Retrieve a Coralogix incident by its incident ID.
actions.getIncidentById.props.incidentId: The Coralogix incident ID to retrieve.
actions.getIncidentEvents.description: Get related events for a specific incident.
actions.listIncidents.description: Retrieve a filtered list of Coralogix incidents.
actions.listIncidents.props.applicationN: Filter by application name(s). Leave empty to return all.
actions.listIncidents.props.pageSize.des: Maximum number of incidents to return.
actions.listIncidents.props.severity.des: Filter by incident severity. Leave empty to return all.
actions.listIncidents.props.status.descr: Filter by incident status. Leave empty to return all.
actions.listIncidents.props.subsystemNam: Filter by subsystem name(s). Leave empty to return all.
actions.resolveIncidents.description: Mark one or more Coralogix incidents as resolved.
actions.resolveIncidents.props.incidentI: List of incident IDs to resolve. Find the ID in Coralogix → Alerts → Incidents → click an incident → copy the ID from the URL.
actions.sendLogs.description: Send a single log to Coralogix Log Ingestion API.
actions.sendLogs.props.applicationName.d: The application name for this log.
actions.sendLogs.props.hiResTimestamp.de: UTC nanoseconds since 1970 as a string. Optional alternative to timestamp.
actions.sendLogs.props.subsystemName.des: The subsystem name for this log.
actions.sendLogs.props.text.description: The log message text or a JSON string.
actions.sendLogs.props.timestamp.descrip: UTC milliseconds since 1970. Leave empty to use ingestion time.
actions.setAlertActive.description: Enable or disable a Coralogix alert definition. Use this to mute alerts during maintenance windows.
actions.setAlertActive.props.active.desc: Turn ON to enable the alert, turn OFF to disable it.
actions.setAlertActive.props.alertId.des: The ID of the alert to enable or disable. Use the "List Alert Definitions" action to find IDs.
auth.description: Management API uses api.coralogix.com. Select ingestion region domain and provide both API keys.
auth.props.coralogixDomain.description: Select your Coralogix regional domain for ingestion endpoints.
auth.props.personalOrTeamApiKey.descript: Used for Coralogix management APIs (for example alert definitions, incidents, dashboards).
auth.props.sendYourDataApiKey.descriptio: Used for Coralogix ingestion APIs (for example /logs/v1/singles). Find it in Settings → API Keys → Send Your Data.
triggers.newAlertEvent.description: Triggers when Coralogix sends an alert-event webhook payload to this flow.
triggers.newAlertEvent.props.setupInstru:
### Webhook setup in Coralogix

1. In Coralogix, go to **Alerts** and open the alert definition you want.
2. Open **Outbound Webhooks** and click **Add webhook**.
3. Select **Generic webhook**.
4. In **Webhook URL**, paste: `{{webhookUrl}}`
5. Keep method as **POST** and content type as **application/json**.
6. Save the webhook, then trigger a test alert to verify events are received.
triggers.newIncident.description: Triggers when a new incident appears in Coralogix. Polls on a schedule — ideal for paging on-call, creating Jira tickets, or posting to Slack.
triggers.newIncident.props.severity.desc: Only trigger for incidents with these severities. Leave empty for all.
